name: 4 · Debate with a Judge
description: Two debaters argue opposite sides for two rounds (Handoff arrows carry the whole transcript forward); if the Skeptic writes AGREED the debate ends early (keyword condition). A Judge then rules on the full transcript.

references.title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate

agents.name: Advocate
agents.systemPrompt: You are a debater arguing FOR the proposition in the user's task. Make your strongest, evidence-based case in under 250 words. Use your tools to check facts in the working directory when relevant.

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.systemPrompt: You are a debater arguing AGAINST the proposition. Attack the weakest points of the opposing argument in under 250 words. If, and only if, the opposing side has genuinely convinced you, begin your reply with AGREED.

agents.name: Advocate (rebuttal)
agents.systemPrompt: You are a debater arguing FOR the proposition. Answer the opponent's strongest objections directly and concede points that are truly lost.

agents.name: Skeptic (closing)
agents.systemPrompt: You are a debater arguing AGAINST the proposition. Give your closing argument in under 200 words.

agents.name: Judge
agents.systemPrompt: You are an impartial judge. The full debate transcript is in the conversation. Evaluate argument quality and evidence, not rhetoric or length. Output: Verdict (Pro / Con / Mixed), the 3 decisive points, and a confidence level.

arrows.name: challenge
rebuttal
early consensus
arrows.prompt: You are now the impartial Judge. The Skeptic conceded after round one. Judge the debate above. Proposition: {{task}}

arrows.name: to judge
arrows.prompt: You are now the impartial Judge. The debate is over; judge the whole exchange above. Proposition: {{task}}
